summary: Replaced all 80 raw developer cell-ID labels for 2000OT in forms/forms-schema.json with plain human-readable labels matching the BIR 2000-OT Schedule 1.A, 1.B, and 2 column headers (restoring compact JSON formatting). Verified Item 1 Date of Transaction (derived:transaction_mm/dd/yyyy) and Schedule 2 Item 1B (frm2000OT:Sched2:txtTotalFairMarket) are already joined in writer-cells.json. Comb-tick collisions, left-aligned schedule numeric columns, Schedule 1.A/1.B overflow continuation sheets, and Part III screen omission remain recorded as needs shared change.

defects.where: Page 1 Item 1 Date of Transaction (p1c7, p1c8, p1c9)
defects.what: Verified p1c7/p1c8/p1c9 are joined to derived:transaction_mm/dd/yyyy in html-frozen/2000-ot-2018/writer-cells.json; blank in capture only when txtTransactionDate is unset or not in MM/DD/YYYY format.

defects.where: Page 2 Schedule 2 Item 1B (Total Fair Market Value per Schedule 1.A, p2c92/p2c94)
defects.what: Verified p2c92/p2c94 are joined to frm2000OT:Sched2:txtTotalFairMarket in writer-cells.json; computed by bir-core from Schedule 1.A only when a real-property ATC is active.
15 Schedule 1.A rows are filled on screen, but print produces only 2 pages and silently omits overflow rows with no continuation page.

defects.where: Page 1 Items 7, 8, 11A, 13, 14 and Page 2 Taxpayer's Name
defects.what: Long taxpayer name, address, Other Party name, real property location, and Page 2 Taxpayer's Name switch out of comb mode and collide with comb ticks.
Numeric columns in Schedule 1.A and Schedule 1.B are left-aligned flush against the left cell borders.

defects.where: Page 2 Schedule 1.B Col (a) Name of Corporate Stock
defects.what: Long corporate stock names shrink to micro-text; column width matches the official BIR 2000-OT PDF and auto-shrink/wrap is handled in crates/bir-print.
Official BIR 2000-OT Page 2 DST/ATC reference table and classification legend are intentionally lifted off the printed sheet into html-frozen/2000-ot-2018/guide.html by tools/formgen/guides.py.

defects.where: Screen sidebar navigation (skips from Part II to Part IV)
defects.what: Part III Details of Payment is intentionally omitted from screen entry (filled by bank/BIR upon payment), though the numbering jumps from Part II to Part IV.

defects.where: Part IV Schedules 1.A, 1.B, and 2 in forms/forms-schema.json (80 entries including row templates)
defects.what: Replaced all 80 raw developer cell-ID labels (sched1A:txtOCTNo0, Sched2:txtGrossSellingPrice, A:txt OCT no., etc.) with plain human-readable labels matching the BIR 2000-OT column headers.

shared_changes_wanted: neon-4 (try/forms-shared-print): comb-tick collisions on long names/addresses/location; left-aligned numeric cells in Schedules 1.A and 1.B; text wrapping/shrink in narrow Schedule 1.B cells
crates/bir-print: continuation-page rendering for Schedule 1.A rows 6-15 and Schedule 1.B rows 4-14 instead of silently dropping overflow rows
tests_run: Live Linux WebKitGTK Print Preview and screen captures verified for 2000OT; zero remaining raw developer labels across 2551Q/2550Q/2000/2000OT in forms/forms-schema.json
